complexity.notes: Converting each mask to a binary string with an f-string is a bit unidiomatic; using bit shifts (i >> j) & 1 or itertools-style backtracking would be cleaner. The true complexity O(n * 2^n) is exponential, so the benchmark model is clamped to the largest representable form in the allowed grammar.
complexity.summary: Iterates over all 2^n bitmasks, formats each index as an n-bit binary string, and collects elements where the bit is '1' to build every subset. The runtime and space are dominated by the output, which contains 2^n subsets of up to n elements each.
